name: Diagonal Slab
description: A full-bleed photo with an angled tone slab cutting across the bottom-left corner (small capitals kicker and a bold headline), and a small pill label top-right.
photoTip: Keep faces out of the bottom-left third, which the slab covers.

tones.note: All six tones work; the slab and pill are the tone colour.

fields.label: Kicker
fields.hint: Optional small capitals above the headline.

fields.label: Headline
fields.hint: Bold, one to three short lines. Use a new line where you want the break.

fields.label: Pill label
fields.hint: Optional short label in the top-right pill, such as 'Limited dates' or 'Autumn 2026'. Not for social handles.
